selected_script.angle: Reaching stubborn pet hair and dust bunnies trapped deep under a low-clearance living room sofa with a flexible, extendable flat duster.
selected_script.hook: Frustrated pet owner crouches on the floor trying to reach under a low sofa with a short lint roller, failing to reach the dust.

script_record.description: 20-second UGC style ad showcasing the transition from struggling to clean under a low sofa to easily sweeping it with the bendable, extendable grey microfiber gap duster.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video (9:16 aspect ratio, realistic handheld phone-shot style). Timeline: 0-3s: Pain conflict. A home user crouches on the floor, struggling to reach under a low-clearance wooden sofa with a short lint roller. Their hand gets blocked by the tight gap, showing frustration. 3-6s: Product solution. Hands manually bend the flat grey duster head of the Replacement Gap Duster to a curve, then smoothly slide the flat duster parallel to the floor deep into the narrow gap under the sofa. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1. The duster head is pulled out, showing the plush grey microfiber sleeve covered in electrostatically trapped dust and pet hair. Ensure the product matches the reference image exactly: plush grey microfiber sleeve head, light blue plastic twist lock connectors, and metallic silver pole. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video (9:16 aspect ratio, realistic handheld phone-shot style). Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2. Close-up of hands twisting the light blue plastic twist lock on the stainless steel pole, extending it axially, locking it, and sliding the extended flat duster parallel into a tight vertical gap beside a wooden cabinet to clean. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3. The plush grey microfiber cover is gently slid off the flexible flat paddle core, demonstrating its removable design. 8-10s: Short CTA. A simple text overlay reads: 'Keep your tight spaces clean.' This segment must continue the visual style, pacing, and identical product appearance (plush grey microfiber head, light blue connectors, metallic pole) from the first segment.
